lines.text: SCENE 1 · A small county courtroom.
BAILIFF: All rise for the Honorable Judge Mercer.
lines.speaker: BAILIFF

lines.text: (Chairs scrape as everyone stands)
JUDGE MERCER: Be seated. Counsel, call your first witness.
lines.speaker: JUDGE MERCER

lines.text: ATTORNEY: The defence calls Mrs Alvarez.
lines.speaker: ATTORNEY

lines.text: (A wooden door opens and closes)
MRS ALVAREZ: I saw him leave the shop at eight, not ten.
lines.speaker: MRS ALVAREZ

lines.text: (A gavel strikes twice)
JUDGE MERCER: Order. One more outburst and I clear the room.
lines.speaker: JUDGE MERCER

lines.text: (A phone buzzes loudly in the gallery)

dialogueBefore.speaker: NOTARIO

lines.text: ESCENA 1 · Despacho de un notario.

lines.text: (Un reloj de bolsillo marca el compás)

lines.speaker: CARMEN

lines.text: TOMÁS: La casa es mía, siempre lo fue.
lines.speaker: TOMÁS

lines.text: (Se vuelca una silla)
NOTARIO: A su sobrina Carmen, el piano. A su sobrino Tomás, las deudas.

lines.text: (Truenos que se acercan)
